'''Linda Laura Sabbadini''' (born 5 May 1956), is an Italian [[statistician]] who is recognized for her pioneering work on [[gender studies]] and central director of the [[Italian National Institute of Statistics]].

== Early life ==
Sabbadini was born 5 May 1956 in [[Rome]], Italy.<ref name="FRLM">{{cite web|url=http://www.ritalevimontalcini.org/prof-ssa-linda-laura-sabbadini/|title=Prof.ssa Linda Laura Sabbadini|author=Fondazione Rita Levi Montalcini|access-date=3 April 2016|archive-date=9 June 2016|url-status=usurped|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160609105901/http://www.ritalevimontalcini.org/prof-ssa-linda-laura-sabbadini/}}</ref>

== Career ==
Sabbadini has been working at [[Italian National Institute of Statistics|ISTAT]] since 1983 and has been a manager since 2000.<ref name=FRLM/> She has dealt in particular with women, well-being, poverty, discrimination, migrants, the environment,[[Sustainability| fair sustainability]],<ref name=FRLM/> and volunteering.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.eesc.europa.eu/?i=portal.en.events-and-activities-statistical-tools-volunteering-presentatio|title=Statistical tools for measuring volunteering and other activities of benefit to society: Public Hearing - EESC, Brussels, Belgium|date=2013}}</ref>

She contributed to the ISTAT study published in 1985 which was a pioneer in the world in showing the value of women's work within the family<ref>{{Cite book|author=Hannes Grandits, Patrick Heady and Peter P. Schweitzer|title=Family, kinship and state in contemporary Europe|url=http://press.uchicago.edu/ucp/books/book/distributed/F/bo8364783.html|access-date=2016-04-03|date=2010-09-15|publisher=Campus |editor=Campus|language=en|isbn=9783593389615}}</ref> and renewed the ISTAT studies in the area since 1990;<ref name=FRLM/> in 1995 the [[World Conference on Women, 1995|World Conference on Women]] in [[Beijing]] declared the importance of such statistical studies on the [[Women's studies|study of women]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Flavia Cristaldi|title=Nazioni unite e politiche di genere: Un processo in via di sviluppo|via=Bollettino della Società geografica italiana|volume=XI|date=2006|url=http://www.lettere.uniroma1.it/sites/default/files/330/Cristaldi_ONU.pdf|page=849|access-date=3 April 2016|archive-date=21 April 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160421165234/http://www.lettere.uniroma1.it/sites/default/files/330/Cristaldi_ONU.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Subsequently, she "created relationships such as Fair and Sustainable Well-being to have an integrated vision between economy, society and environment in the evolution of the country".<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.lastampa.it/2016/04/01/italia/politica/listat-solleva-dallincarico-linda-laura-sabbadini-la-pioniera-delle-statistiche-sulle-donne-5XpV8Fl5nTVsaBLdwlFPRP/pagina.html|title=L'Istat solleva dall'incarico la Sabbadini|date=2016-04-01|newspaper=[[La Stampa]]|access-date=2016-04-03|author=Alessandra Di Pietro}}</ref>

=== Poverty and social exclusion ===
Under her direction, the set of inequality and poverty measures has been significantly expanded and enriched, allowing for in-depth analyses of the dynamics of [[social inequality]] in Italy.{{cn|date=May 2025}}

From 2003 to 2009 she was a member of the Commission of Inquiry into Social Exclusion (CIES),[[Linda Laura Sabbadini#cite note-2|<sup>[2]</sup>]] established by the [[Ministry of Labour and Social Policies (Italy)|Ministry of Labour and Social Policies]].

Between 2009 and 2010 she was a member of the Commission for the revision of the methodology for the estimation of absolute poverty established at ISTAT which proposed an innovative methodology also at an international level.<ref>{{cite web|language=IT |title=Una Nuova Poverta Assoluta |date=5 May 2009 |url=http://www.lavoce.info/archives/25663/una-nuova-poverta-assoluta/}}<!-- auto-translated from unknown (Italian or Spanish) by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

Under her direction, the methodological restructuring of the survey on [[Consumption function|consumption expenditure]] was conducted, which allowed for a significant improvement in the quality of poverty estimates, and the new methodology for estimating homelessness was developed, which also involved the associations most in contact with the homeless population.{{cn|date=May 2025}}

=== Fair and sustainable well-being ===
She directed the design and implementation of the indicators of equitable and sustainable well-being for which Italy played a leading role on a global level.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.istat.it/it/benessere-e-sostenibilit%C3%A0/misure-del-benessere|title=Misure del Benessere Equo e Sostenibile|access-date=31 May 2018|archive-date=14 May 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180514180202/https://www.istat.it/it/benessere-e-sostenibilit%C3%A0/misure-del-benessere|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Together with [[Maria Teresa Salvemini]], she coordinated the CNEL-ISTAT Steering Committee for the definition of progress and well-being of Italian society, which brought together representatives of [[civil society]]. Together with the President of ISTAT, she coordinated the Scientific Commission for the measurement of Well-being.

She edited the Reports on Equitable and Sustainable Well-being until 2015 and produced scientific publications on well-being at a national and international level.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.istat.it/it/archivio/84348|title=Rapporto sul benessere equo e sostenibile 2013|language=IT}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|language=IT |title=Rapporto sul benessere equo e sostenibile 2014 |url=https://www.istat.it/it/archivio/126613}}<!-- auto-translated from unknown (Italian or Spanish) by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{cite web|language=IT |title=Rapporto sul benessere equo e sostenibile 2015 |url=https://www.istat.it/it/archivio/175169}}<!-- auto-translated from unknown (Italian or Spanish) by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

She was a member of the Friends of the Chair of the [[United Nations|UN]] on broader measures of progress on sustainable development indicators, which included the Presidents of the National Institutes of Statistics, for the advanced role played by Italy on measures of well-being.<ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2Fs11205-017-1766-2|title=Quality of Life in Italian Official Surveys|date=2018 |doi=10.1007/s11205-017-1766-2 |last1=Sabbadini |first1=Linda Laura |last2=Maggino |first2=Filomena |journal=Social Indicators Research |volume=135 |issue=3 |pages=1043–1055 |url-access=subscription |hdl=2158/503471 |hdl-access=free }}</ref>

=== Gender differences ===
A pioneer of gender statistics, in 1995 she participated in the World Conference on Women in Beijing, editing the volume Tempi Diversi - translated into 4 languages and distributed during the same conference - focused on the organization of the life times of men and women in Italy which, for the first time, contains the measure of the amount of [[unpaid work]].

The gender approach has always been combined with the measurement of quality of life, through the conduct of numerous surveys on all aspects of social life, collecting information on the behaviors, expectations and feelings of Italians.

Even before international recommendations existed, she directed the planning and implementation of the estimation of [[Gender-related violence|gender violence]], including its hidden part. For this reason, she provided an important contribution within the UN group to define the guidelines for measuring [[violence against women]] at a global level.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.un.org/press/en/2017/wom2112.doc.htm|title=Using Gender Statistics Crucial for Realizing Sustainable Development Agenda, Speakers Say, as Commission on Status of Women Continues Session |publisher=United Nations}}</ref>

Under her direction, measures of [[male fertility]], [[Sextortion|sexual blackmail]] at work,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.lastampa.it/2018/02/14/societa/un-milione-di-donne-vittime-sul-lavoro-di-ricatti-sessuali-jdpoptpm3cq0k3s2JsCSwL/pagina.html|title=Un milione di donne vittime sul lavoro di ricatti sessuali|work=La Stampa|date=14 February 2018 |language=IT}}</ref> the sacrifices and discriminations suffered by women, the difficulties encountered in the course of life, the forms of family life experimented with, the causes of the low [[birth rate]] were defined.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.istat.it/it/files/2011/02/Sabbadini.pdf|title=Mobilità sociale e traiettorie di vita: il percorso della statistica ufficiale|website=istat.it|language=IT}}</ref>

She has published numerous scientific articles and [[Monograph|monographs]] concerning the different dimensions of social life, overcoming the '[[Gender-blind|gender blind]]' approach that had characterized official statistics until the 1980s.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wien.gv.at/statistik/pdf/genderstatistics-english.pdf|title=Gender-sensitive statistics: Making life’s realities visible|website=wien.gv.at|access-date=31 May 2018|archive-date=21 December 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161221032126/https://www.wien.gv.at/statistik/pdf/genderstatistics-english.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

She collaborated with the National Equality Commission, with the [[Minister for Equal Opportunities|Ministers for Equal Opportunities]], was part of the Inter-ministerial Commission for the support of victims of [[Human trafficking|trafficking]], violence and serious exploitation<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.senato.it/japp/bgt/showdoc/frame.jsp?tipodoc=SommComm&leg=17&id=01066513&part=doc_dc&parse=no&aj=no|title=Atti Commissione Parlamentare di inchiesta sul femminicidio, nonché su ogni forma di violenza di genere.|website=senato.it|language=IT}}</ref> of the Inter-ministerial Commission against [[Genital modification and mutilation|genital mutilation]] established at the Department for Rights and Equal Opportunities.

She was Coordinator of the Integrated Data System Group on Violence against Women within the Government Task Force on Violence against Women under the [[Letta Government]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.radioradicale.it/scheda/533406/molestie-su-donne-e-uomini-i-dati-istat-il-metoo-italiano-commentato-da-linda-laura|title=Dati Violenza Sulle Donne in Italia|date=14 February 2018|website=radioradicale.it|language=IT}}</ref>

She participated several times in the [[United Nations Commission on the Status of Women|UN Commission on the Status of Women]] as a member of the government delegation for the statistical function.

She has been a member of UN high-level groups on gender statistics and in particular since 2007 she has been a member of the UN Interagency and expert group on gender statistics.

She participated in the [[G7]] of women in 2017 ''Starting from girls. Women Forum on inequality and sustainable growth''<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.aspeninstitute.it/en/programs/starting-girlswomen%E2%80%99s-forum-inequality-and-sustainable-growth | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170815054753/http://www.aspeninstitute.it/en/programs/starting-girlswomen%E2%80%99s-forum-inequality-and-sustainable-growth | archive-date=15 August 2017 | title=Starting from girls.Women's Forum on inequality and sustainable growth &#124; Aspen Institute Italia }}</ref> and edited the statistical part of the G7 2017 in [[Taormina]]. She was a columnist for the newspaper ''[[La Stampa]]'' in 2016, moving on to the newspaper ''[[la Repubblica]]'' on 27 April 2020.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.festivalstatistica.it/2024/linda-laura-sabbadini/|title=Linda Laura Sabbadini|date=14 October 2024 |language=IT}}</ref>
